answer_1.quote: Knowledge-grounded conversation is the task where the model could reply to a dialogue history based on extra knowledge. ... we explore the possibility of leveraging large models as a new knowledge source for unsupervised knowledge-grounded conversation. ... we design a human evaluation protocol and conduct an extensive quality assessment of the generated knowledge. ... These observations advocate the unique value of employing large models as knowledge bases.

answer_2.quote: In automatic evaluation, we compute the unigram F1 between the generated knowledge and the ground truth knowledge. ... In the automatic evaluation, we report the perplexity (PPL) and Unigram F1 of ground truth responses. We also collect the top-1 knowledge accuracy (P@1) statistics ...

answer_4.quote: we recruit three well-trained annotators who are fluent in English to evaluate 100 random samples from the seen and unseen test sets each, according to the scheme we proposed in Section 2.2. ... They will evaluate these samples in four aspects, following : • Coherent measures whether the response is consistent with the dialogue history. • Informativeness evaluates whether the response is generic and non-informative or not. • Engagingness assesses how likely the annotator is willing to continue the discussion. • Hallucination checks the correctness of the contained factual information.
answer_4.guideline: Annotation tagset in Table 1 for knowledge evaluation and four aspects (Coherent, Informativeness, Engagingness, Hallucination) for response evaluation.
